data.one_liner: A lightweight event bus using Dart Streams for publish/subscribe communication
data.what_it_does: It allows any Dart object to be fired as an event and listened to via streams. Listeners can filter by event type or listen to all events. It supports synchronous and asynchronous buses and custom stream controllers.
use_when: You need a simple global event bus for decoupling components
You want to avoid complex state management libraries for small projects
You need to broadcast events across different parts of an app without tight coupling
avoid_when: You require advanced state management with reactive UI updates
You need dependency injection or service locator patterns
You are building a large-scale application that prefers a more structured architecture like BLoC or Redux
strengths: Supports both sync and async buses
weaknesses: No built-in lifecycle or cleanup management
Not a full state management solution
Can lead to hard-to-track event flows in large apps
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package:event_bus/event_bus.dart

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more structured state management pattern with streams and events, suitable for larger apps
